mostWorthwhile.text: Making the membrane patch was most worthwhile: the water-facing heads and water-avoiding tails explained why it forms two layers.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the water channel was clear but predictable after seeing its pore and the goal.

surprise.text: I learned that oxygen crosses the oily middle, while water crosses slowly and can use channels to move faster.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each pairing a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing how the pieces fit together made the membrane easier to understand, although the choices here were fairly straightforward.
